evidence: Films grown on SiO 2 and on cleaned In 0.53Ga0.47As surfaces were characterized by means of X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) and XPS in order to asses the structural and chemical characteristics of the oxide/semiconductor interfaces. XPS was generated by a standard Mg K α (1253.6 eV) and Al K α (1486.6 eV) source using a pass energy of 20 eV and a take-off-angle of 70 ◦. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements were performed on In0.53Ga0.47As-based MOS capacitors fabricated including Al 2O3 and Al-ZrO2 ﬁlms (∼11 nm thick) as dielectric gate stacks.
